preview.text: Bahrain and Thailand meet in a T20 match at YSD-UKM Cricket Oval, having previously played 3 recorded T20 meetings where Bahrain won 2 and Thailand won 1. Thailand won the toss and chose to bowl first in conditions where the usual first-innings score in the 10 recorded T20 matches at YSD-UKM Cricket Oval is 125. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 100 per cent chance of rain and about 29 degrees.

summary.text: Bahrain won by 7 runs. BHR made 104-6, Junaid Aziz top-scoring with 26 off 27 balls; Nopphon Senamontree took 2 for 15. THAI made 97-8, Pattarapol Jirapatananukul top-scoring with 23 off 25 balls; Asif Javed Basher Ahmed took 3 for 14. Sides batting first at YSD-UKM Cricket Oval usually make about 125.
